tests.name: Clock: the minute hand turns, the hour hand follows
From the dial to two gears: the dial lifts away
Count: one turn of the small gear lights ten teeth on each gear
One gear: the large gear grows to 120 teeth
Train: the arrows size the last gear, 32 teeth make twelve times slower
From one gear to two steps: the last gear arrives at the size it says, in mesh with its pinion
From two steps to the centre: a last gear left at 24 teeth grows back to 32, still in mesh
Centre: a click on the last gear rolls it back to the centre
Answer: the dial seen through, on a phone
